dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Mira, do you like mua sắm at Ben Thanh Market? I see many foreigners like to buy souvenirs there.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I don't thích mua sắm much. Mua sắm wastes time and money. I thích spending time playing cờ vua more. But... if you want to go mua sắm with me, I might reconsider.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Actually, I'm not really someone who thích mua sắm either. But I think going mua sắm with you would be interesting. Maybe we could find a beautiful cờ vua set at the market? I know an antique shop that has many unique cờ vua sets.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Cờ vua? You know how to play cờ vua? Not many Americans know how to play cờ vua... I didn't think you were someone with the patience to learn this game. But if you really want to buy a cờ vua set, I'll help you choose a good one.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I'm not as good as you, but my grandfather taught me when I was young. He used to say that cờ vua helps people understand each other without many words. Perhaps... that's why I want to play cờ vua with you, Mira.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Really? I... I don't know what to say. No one has ever wanted to understand me that way. But you should know, I'm not easy to defeat...
